player_directive: Continue the campaign from the completed Round 112 state.

events.title: THE FIRST RECORDED SILVER EXTRACTION IS TESTED AGAINST THE NEW MINE MAP
events.body: The newly opened workings produce their first measured trial extraction from the most accessible mapped vein. Lucius Atilius and Gnaeus Fabius have the material weighed and recorded against the survey notation before any wider production schedule is adopted. The result confirms workable silver-bearing material in the mapped section, but the quantity is treated as a trial output rather than as proof of the yield of the deeper branches. The miners therefore continue cautiously, preserving the distinction between observed production and projected reserves. No sale is booked because the material remains within the estate's production chain.

classification_audit.causal_basis: Foreseeable development of an established campaign, infrastructure, commercial, security, or agricultural thread; not the immediate latest player action.

events.title: THE PUBLIC STRATEGIC ROAD RECEIVES ITS FIRST CLASS-SPECIFIC MAINTENANCE RECORD
events.body: The completed road classification is translated into a practical maintenance register. The oldest strategic spine is recorded separately from the later commercial branches and private estate spurs, with each class assigned the maintenance responsibility appropriate to its legal and functional status. Servilius and Cassius review the physical descriptions against their investigation notes so that the registry preserves what was actually observed rather than merely repeating an administrative label. The process establishes a durable reference for future repairs and access decisions.

classification_audit.causal_basis: Foreseeable development of an established campaign, infrastructure, commercial, security, or agricultural thread; not the immediate latest player action.

events.title: THE HOLIDAY-WEEK SURPLUS CONSIGNMENT REACHES THE WATER ROAD
events.body: A scheduled surplus delivery moves through the shared-water road despite the seasonal slowdown in ordinary traffic. The merchants accept a smaller mixed consignment than the previous settlement, producing 39 denarii in gross receipts against 15 denarii in operating and transport costs. The resulting 24 denarii of net public profit is settled under the standing agreement, with 2.4 denarii routed privately and 21.6 denarii retained publicly. The settlement differs from the prior one because the quantity available and current winter transport conditions differ.

classification_audit.causal_basis: Foreseeable development of an established campaign, infrastructure, commercial, security, or agricultural thread; not the immediate latest player action.

events.title: A SECONDARY SILVER VEIN PROVES MORE CONTINUOUS THAN THE SURVEYORS EXPECTED
events.body: While following the mapped boundary of a secondary vein, the miners encounter a continuous mineral-bearing section that extends farther along the marked alignment than their initial working face had suggested. The discovery does not establish the total reserve of the mine, but it materially expands the portion of the vein that can now be treated as observed rather than conjectural. Atilius orders the new continuation marked before further excavation proceeds, preserving the survey's separation between confirmed ground and unexplored depth. The result changes the working plan for the secondary vein without creating speculative revenue.

classification_audit.causal_basis: Unexpected but causally grounded development within the established silver-working thread.

events.title: VALERIUS'S CIVIC PAPERS PASS INTO THE NEXT PROCEDURAL FILE
events.body: The documents associated with Valerius's candidacy are entered into the next procedural file after the campaign staff complete the required preparation. Officials acknowledge receipt of the materials and record the candidacy as continuing through the established process. No vote, endorsement, appointment, or electoral result is recorded. The campaign's recent intelligence expenditure therefore continues to manifest as administrative preparation rather than an outcome that has not yet occurred.

classification_audit.causal_basis: Foreseeable development of an established campaign, infrastructure, commercial, security, or agricultural thread; not the immediate latest player action.

events.title: THE ESTATE'S OPEN FACILITIES HANDLE WINTER TRAFFIC UNDER THE COST-RECOVERY RULE
events.body: The estate's merchant facilities continue serving lawful Roman users under the standing indiscriminate-access rule. Current facility and transport charges total 12 denarii for the accounting period, while the directly associated operating costs also total 12 denarii. The accounts therefore close at exact cost recovery, with no profit routed privately and no subsidy required from the public account. The stewards retain the same rule for users regardless of status or personal connection.

classification_audit.causal_basis: Foreseeable development of an established campaign, infrastructure, commercial, security, or agricultural thread; not the immediate latest player action.

events.title: TITUS VARENUS REORGANIZES THE GUARD'S ROAD WATCH AROUND THE THREE ROAD CLASSES
events.body: Titus Varenus completes the first full adjustment of the guard's road-watch routine after the network's classification has been incorporated into estate administration. The fifty infantry and fifty cavalry remain available, but their patrol emphasis is divided between the public strategic spine, commercial branches, and estate access routes rather than treating every road segment alike. The reorganization produces no mobilization and no reduction in readiness. It establishes a standing security practice consistent with the completed investigation.

classification_audit.causal_basis: Foreseeable development of an established campaign, infrastructure, commercial, security, or agricultural thread; not the immediate latest player action.

events.title: WINTER WORK CONTINUES ON THE NEWLY CULTIVATED SIX-ACRE PARCEL
events.body: The six-acre parcel continues through its winter cultivation cycle as the cultivators maintain drainage and protect the planted ground. No harvest has yet occurred, and the capped agriculture metric remains unchanged. The parcel nevertheless continues to function as productive estate land rather than as a dormant acquisition. No new acreage or immediate agricultural revenue is realized in this round.
